title: Polyamory
summary: Polyamory means having multiple loving relationships at the same time with the knowledge and consent of everyone involved. It differs from cheating because it's open and agreed.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
